name: Final General
body:
Hi {username},

Your assets are ready, and everything is attached to this delivery.

I have also added a Drive link below so you can download everything in one go.
{drive link}

Everything from your package is in there and ready to use straight away. If you are happy with how it turned out, you can go ahead and mark the order as complete whenever you get a moment.

It was a good project to work on. If you need anything for the brand later, just message me right here. I already have your files and your style saved, so future work will be faster and more consistent.

Thanks,
Team XStudioz

name: Thanks General
body:
Hi {username},

Thank you for placing your order with us. It has been received and passed to our team.

Your requirements are now with the team and the design stage begins from there. If anything needs clarifying once we have been through them, we will come back to you here before going any further.

Your first designs will be with you within the delivery date shown on your order. These show you the direction we have taken. Have a proper look when they arrive and let us know what you think.

Kind regards,
